pages.text: Research on Chishi technology follows a clear mainline, and diary chapters unlock as you progress:$(br)$(li)$(bold)Ore Clusters$(): mine your first cluster$(li)$(bold)Chishi Crystal$(): craft Raw Chishi Blocks$(li)$(bold)Chi Energy$(): craft the Purifier and ignite the flame$(li)$(bold)Logistics$(): craft Item Pipes and free your hands$(li)$(bold)Equipment$(): condense Chishi Ingots and forge your armament$(li)$(bold)Life Energy$(): touch the higher form beyond Chi$(br2)Each step unlocks a new chapter - follow the progress and you will never lose your way.
